curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two mismatched travelers survive the brutal elements long enough to deliver their fragile charges eastward?
curatedMovie.description: On the unforgiving frontier, pioneer Mary Bee Cuddy enlists drifter George Briggs to help transport three women across the harsh Nebraska Territories to refuge in Iowa.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Bleak, slow-burning frontier drama demanding patient, solitary focus amidst heavy psychological stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Tommy Lee Jones offers an austere, psychologically fraught frontier drama anchored by heavy stakes and constant, quiet suspense.
